## History

Timothy Cotton spent twenty years practicing how to die before he finally passed away. In his past, he stole a crock of butter from Mrs. Lynde's dairy and falsely told his wife that he had bought it from her.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P10](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0010), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
